scope: Text generation speed and serving measurements. No coding correctness, writing quality, vision accuracy or tool-use quality scores are claimed.

profiles.label: Original writing suite
profiles.description: The original essay prompts: 16-token warmup, three measured requests capped at 256 output tokens, temperature 0, thinking off where supported, one request at a time. Flash was added on 29 September against its already loaded server. Engine timing formulas and server profiles differ.

profiles.label: Archived supplementary TensorFold tests
profiles.description: Separate coding, sampled chat and variable-context tests. Rounded results with incomplete trial metadata; shown separately from the controlled writing suite.

profiles.label: Coding
profiles.description: Python job queue implementation with validation, retry, recovery, and tests; throughput only, no correctness score.

profiles.label: Chat
profiles.description: Conversational explanation of planning a home computer lab; throughput only, no response quality score.

profiles.label: Installed runtime compatibility check
profiles.description: Unsupported engine/checkpoint configurations are identified before GPU allocation. They have no generation speed, latency or trial median.
